description:
Inference provenance metadata required for v3 replay.

All hash values MUST be lowercase hex prefixed with ``sha256:`` per
spec §4.6. The Pydantic layer enforces the prefix.

inference_backend.description: Name of the backend that produced the verdict, e.g. 'ollama-v3', 'fake-llm'.
inference_backend.title: Inference Backend

kg_signer_key_id.description: Key ID of the Ed25519 key the Knowledge Graph signature verified against: 'sha256:' + hex sha256 of the raw 32-byte public key. None when the KG was unsigned.
kg_signer_key_id.title: Kg Signer Key Id

kg_trust.description: 'anchored': the KG signature verified against an operator-pinned trust anchor (SKI_KG_TRUST_ANCHORS). 'unanchored': no anchors, SKI_KG_ALLOW_UNANCHORED=true, checked only against the KG's own embedded key (dev only). 'unsigned': KG_REQUIRE_SIGNATURE=false loaded a KG with no signature (dev only).
kg_trust.title: Kg Trust

model_hash_verified.description: True only when an operator pin (SKI_MODEL_FILE_SHA256) matched a weights digest the runtime obtained independently of that pin. False means model_weight_hash is unverified: an unpinned backend digest, an operator-asserted value, or a name commitment that is NOT a weight hash.
model_hash_verified.title: Model Hash Verified

title: ModelProvenance
